payload.blocks: ACE phase 2, and phase 3 after it (phase 3 waits for phases 1 and 2). Phase 3 and 4 units also compile pkm, so they will hit the same wall.
payload.headline: ACE phase 2 (pkm probe) cannot build pkm inside a unit sandbox; who runs the probe?

parts.cause: The unit sandbox has no network (git fetch fails) and cannot read ~/.cargo/git/checkouts, so cargo cannot resolve the pkm git dependency. The lead cannot place a copy of the dependencies either: its shell writes only the plan directory. fgos run has no flag to grant network or a read path.

options.cost: One confinement change plus one rerun.
options.does: Supervisor/owner widens the unit confinement to read CARGO_HOME (registry and git checkouts), then the lead reruns phase 2 on claude with --offline builds.
options.gain: Fixes phase 2 and every later Rust unit (phases 3, 4) that links pkm; no network needed.
options.harm: A confinement change outside this plan; needs its owner.
options.label: Let unit sandboxes read ~/.cargo

options.does: The supervisor runs phase 2 once as an urgent chore (fgos run from its own seat) or the owner runs it by hand in the p02 worktree.
options.gain: Unblocks phase 2 now with no code change.
options.harm: Phase 3 and 4 units will hit the same wall later.
options.label: Run the probe from an unconfined session

options.does: Someone with write access runs cargo vendoring into .fgos/runtime/tmp/ace-pkm-probe/ in the p02 worktree (untracked), then the lead reruns.
options.harm: Hand step repeated per worktree; does not scale to phase 3.
options.label: Pre-copy dependencies into the worktree

parts.recommendation: Let unit sandboxes read ~/.cargo: every later phase of this plan compiles pkm, so fixing it once in the confinement is cheaper than a hand step per phase.

scope.allows: Changing how the probe gets the pkm source and rerunning phase 2 in worktree 261125-1631-agent-context-engine-p02.
scope.forbids: Changing the phase 2 brief, the pkm tag, or the plan footprint.

parts.what: Three phase 2 runs failed. Gemini: account gemini/tetnu quarantined. Deepseek via pi: stopped by output-limit after 14 min (per-token thinking stream). Claude/sonnet (unit-run-1795627265269-4ffa221a): blocked in 1 min, could not fetch or read pkm v0.7.0.
